scripts.test: pnpm test:pack && pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:py
scripts.eval: pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec vitest run tests/main/eval --config vitest.eval.config.ts --exclude tests/main/eval/live-eval.test.ts
scripts.eval:live: pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec vitest run tests/main/eval/live-eval.test.ts --config vitest.eval.config.ts
scripts.package:py: uv run --project services/agent-runtime --locked pyinstaller --noconfirm --distpath services/agent-runtime/dist --workpath services/agent-runtime/dist/_pyi-work services/agent-runtime/packaging/personal_agent.spec
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:ts && pnpm lint:py && pnpm test
